messages:
morgan: heads up — onboarding sampleapp hitting two weird things with embeddings+rerank after the latest SDK patch. node returns 1536-d vectors, python returns 1024. sometimes we get duplicate batch sends when auth refreshes mid-batch. repro below.

morgan: repro steps:
```
# run sampleapp (node)
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood-open-embed-1536', input: ['doc1','doc2'] })
# run sampleapp (python)
client.embeddings.create(model='redwood-open-embed-1536', input=['doc1','doc2'])
```

morgan: logs (node):
```
INFO batcher: batch queued size=2 id=0x9a
INFO batcher: sending batch id=0x9a target=embeddings
WARN auth: token expired, refreshing
INFO retry: requeueing batch id=0x9a after refresh
INFO batcher: sending batch id=0x9a target=embeddings
```

morgan: result (node): vectors shape [2, 1536]
morgan: result (python): vectors shape [2, 1024]
morgan: cc @tia @eli — this breaks our retriever demo and the rerank helper expects 1536 everywhere. :facepalm:

tia: repro here. also noticed the node sdk's batching helper will resend the same batch if the auth refresh flow returns a 401 then a 200 on retry. looks like we don't dedupe by batch-id.

tia: short-term fix: adjust sampleapp to normalize dims on ingest (pad/truncate) and guard against duplicate ids. long-term we should make SDK batching idempotent across retries.

eli: thanks for the report. quick questions: which sdk versions are you running for node/python? and which model exactly (the repo lists redwood-open-embed-1536 but model mapping might have aliasing).

morgan: node 1.4.2, python 0.9.8, model string is exactly 'redwood-open-embed-1536' in both places. i pulled responses and verified dims before any client-side postprocessing.

samir: tagging eng-runtime. could be a model-selection fallback on one runtime (e.g., when capacity low we return a quantized 1024 variant). we do have automatic variant fallbacks in routing. if auth triggers during routing it might fall back to a cheaper variant and then retry the same batch with the original model name.

eli: that aligns — fallback logic currently matches by model name family but doesn't assert vector_dim equality. we should add a compatibility check and surface a warning header in responses when variant mismatch happens.

tia: also filing an issue for SDK parity: node's embed client exposes batchId on the sent payload; python didn't. that's probably why dedupe wasn't possible cross-SDK in sampleapp integrations.

morgan: created quick PR in sampleapp that does two things: 1) sanity-check dims and throw an error if mismatch; 2) assigns a client-side uuid per logical batch so we can dedupe duplicate sends until SDKs fix it. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/432

eli: nice. i'll open an eng-runtime card to add the response header and a routing guard. tagging @samir for infra behaviors.

samir: putting a hotfix on infra to prefer strict variant mapping when client sets "require_vector_dim" in request meta. i'll add telemetry for how often fallback->retry happens.

devex-bot: incident created #INC-2026-embeddings-fallback (assigned to eng-runtime). automated tests added: sampleapp embed parity smoke.

tia: long term action items for triage: (1) SDK parity audit for embed/ rerank options (node vs python) (2) idempotent batching primitives in both SDKs (3) response warning header + routing guard (4) sampleapp: normalize or fail loudly on dim mismatch.

morgan: thanks all. i'll keep PR up-to-date and will patch the sampleapp docs to call out the dim check. if anyone can review the sampleapp PR that'd speed things up.

tia: reviewing now. quick nits only. :thumbsup:
